about: The wings of the dungeons run in parts: each creature and object placed inside to the wing of the nearest boss, each quest to the wings its objectives are in (how: one, all = needs each, any = either, outside = none inside; by: [objective kind, target, wings], or [start|end, null, wings] for the giver or ender standing in a wing, or [kb, statement id, wings] for a quest the knowledge base places). Read by wowstats/plan/wings.py; built by tools/dungeon_wings/export.py, do not edit.
